steps.input:
g=[[0]*11 for _ in range(11)]
markers=[(0,10),(1,1),(1,6),(3,1),(5,3),(5,8),(8,0),(9,1),(9,10),(10,6)]
for r,c in markers:g[r][c]=2
seed=(5,6); r,c=seed; g[r][c]=3
# Spiral legs: up, right, down, left; lengths 2,2,4,4,...; stop immediately before first 2 or edge.
dirs=[(-1,0),(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1)]
length=2; leg=0; stopped=False
while not stopped:
 dr,dc=dirs[leg%4]
 for _ in range(length):
  nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
  if not(0<=nr<11 and 0<=nc<11) or g[nr][nc]==2:
   stopped=True; break
  r,c=nr,nc; g[r][c]=3
 if leg%2==1: length+=2
 leg+=1
import json; print(json.dumps(g))
